summary: Iteration 13: Full testing of new StreamVault features: version popup, EPG purple cards, sidebar new nav items, User Settings page, App Info page, Admin Media Catalog tab (CRUD + cast + upload areas). All 26 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend flows verified with Playwright. One critical code-level bug found in ChannelFeatured.jsx (setIsMuted not defined - latent bug when stream is playing).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 235: `onClick={() => showVideo && setIsMuted(m => !m)}` — `setIsMuted` is NOT defined anywhere in the component. When showVideo=true (stream playing) and user clicks the preview card, a ReferenceError will be thrown. Currently silent in test env because channels have no stream URLs. Fix: replace with volume toggle logic e.g. `setVolume(v => v === 0 ? getStoredVolume() || 0.3 : 0)` or simply remove the click handler.

Code review confirms volume toggle btn (data-testid=volume-toggle-btn) and slider (data-testid=volume-slider with showVolSlider state) are correctly implemented. Volume initializes at 30% from localStorage (getStoredVolume). Video starts unmuted (muted=false set in useEffect).

rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Configure a channel with a valid HLS stream URL. 2. Navigate to the Guide tab. 3. Select the channel — stream should play (showVideo=true). 4. Click on the preview card. 5. Browser console throws: ReferenceError: setIsMuted is not defined
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The `isMuted` state and `setIsMuted` setter were removed from the component (in favor of volume-based muting), but the `onClick` handler on the channel-preview-card div (line 235) still references the old `setIsMuted` setter. The JavaScript short-circuit evaluation (`showVideo && setIsMuted(...)`) prevents the error when `showVideo` is false, but will trigger it when a stream is actively playing.
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Replace line 235: `onClick={() => showVideo && setIsMuted(m => !m)}` with: `onClick={() => showVideo && setVolume(v => v === 0 ? (getStoredVolume() || 0.3) : 0)}` — this toggles mute via the volume state which is the correct approach.
